author: Kushal
problem: deliveries lists (item, kg) for each delivery a food bank received this week. Return a dict with how many kilograms of each item were received in total.
bug_description: Stores each delivery's weight instead of adding it to what was already received, so an item delivered more than once only keeps its last delivery.

comments.accurate: Returns the total kilograms received of each item
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the kilograms of each item from its most recent delivery
comments.wrong_location: Weight lookup checked; item names may need lowercasing so 'Rice' and 'rice' match
